entries.category_description: Supply of services by writers, composers and performing artists, or of the royalties due to them
entries.comment:
Performing artists exempted if their services are rendered directly to the organisors according to article 44, §2, 8° of the Belgian VAT Code. The exemption only applies to:
- artists (actors, conductors, musicians and other artists for the performance of theatrical, choreographic, cinematographic or musical works or those of circus shows,music halls or artistic cabaret)
- speakers in meeting on educational topics for the participants
- sport professionals.

entries.category_description: Supply of services by writers, composers and performing artists, or of the royalties due to them
entries.comment: According to Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XXIX, 2°, the services relating to the performance of theatrical, choreographic, musical works, circus, music hall or artistic cabaret shows and similar activities, which fall within the normal activity of actors, conductors'orchestra, musicians and other artists, even if these services are provided by a legal person with the exception of the advertising services. The reduced rate applies to 90.01 and 90.03 in that context.

Admission to shows, theatres, circuses, fairs, amusement parks, concerts, museums, zoos, cinemas, exhibitions and similar cultural events and facilities
entries.comment: Including entrance fees for rides in amusement parks. Usually exempted or out of the scope of VAT if organized by non-profit making organizations or public bodies.

entries.category_description: Services provided by writers, composers and performers and the royalties due to them
Supply of services by writers, composers and performing artists, or of the royalties due to them
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. b.17: performances by performing artists. This includes performances by artists in music and stage performances as meant in the foregoing item. The reduced VAT rate only applies to performances that can be (in)directly heard or viewed by an audience. Rehearsals associated with and necessary for those performances are included. Excluded: providing the opportunity to participate in a performance and organizing performances.
